abstract: This study combines RNA sequencing data from 1,824 tumors across major lung cancer types to examine how tumor gene expression patterns relate to histologic diagnoses. The resulting reference landscape identifies nine transcriptional clusters, including a neuroendocrine-like adenocarcinoma group and regions with mixed histology. The clusters also show associations with clinical features, genetic alterations, immune characteristics, and survival. An interactive Oncoscape resource allows researchers to explore the integrated data and compare patient tumors with patient-derived xenograft models.
